secret_locator_slug.description: the stable slug in a lastsecrets:// secret locator

secret_display_name.description: the non-secret display name of a secret

secret_provider_name.description: the service or system to which a secret belongs

secret_usage_description.description: the non-secret description of the intended use of a secret

secret_environment_name.description: the named environment in which a secret is used

secret_text_envelope.description: a secret text value inside its value envelope; excluded from automatic search

secret_created_at.description: the RFC 3339 instant when a secret record was created

secret_updated_at.description: the RFC 3339 instant when a secret record was last updated

secret_metadata_bucket_key.description: the exact key of a secret metadata list; __all__ names the complete local list

secret_metadata_list_json.description: a JSON-encoded array of secret metadata records with no secret text values

secret_metadata_updated_at.description: the RFC 3339 instant when a secret metadata list was last updated
